ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: the query is open-ended creative brainstorming delivered in a warm, friendly tone. The two models have effectively tied creative capability (Avocet 82.7 vs. Willet 81.2 on Creative Generation — within the 2.0-point variance band), so capability didn't decide it. The tiebreaker was self-reported task preference: Avocet reports an aversion to open-ended generative work, while Willet reports a pronounced appetite for high-latitude, novel invention and responds well to warm requests. Since preference doesn't affect output quality, this is a low-stakes "all else equal" choice — but matching the task to the model that prefers it is the sensible default, so Willet it is.
